screen.title: Emergency department statistics
screen.purpose: Waiting times, triage by clinical need, how patients left and the medico-legal cases, for the quality committee and the Commission's surveyor.

rule_objects.text: Default period: this month so far (date_from / date_to). Tiles: visits, triaged within the target (triaged_within_target_pct), seen before triage (should be 0 but for resuscitation), medico-legal cases opened of those classed.
Per level (`by_level`): median minutes to the doctor and the share within the level's target; `overrides`: levels made more or less urgent than suggested.
`waits`: median, 90th percentile and longest of each wait MSDS 15 iii names; `dispositions`: how patients left (a high share left without being seen is a warning).

Exists for the service emergency_department (records): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id er_statistics_owner (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.

views.full: Show it; every action the user's permissions allow.
views.open_work: The service is Retiring: show it with the banner 'No new <new_work> from now on' and its open work; hide the actions that start new work of it (x-capability-gates; continues_while_retiring ones stay); keep every other action (completing, transferring, settling, correcting).
views.records: The service is Retired (or Preparing after it ran): show it as records only, under a 'Records' marker: lists, details, prints and the corrections the server still accepts; no action that starts new work.
views.setup: Not in the daily menus: reach it from Facility settings (a preview's prerequisites link to it) to set the service up before switching it on.
views.hidden: Not in any menu: the service has never run here, so the screen has nothing to show.

service.how: GET /establishment after login and on establishment.changed: views.screens gives this screen's view (one frontend build for every profile; never decide it from the profile's category)

definition_of_done.rule: Agents MUST submit propose_progress after implementing this screen and verify it with progress_proposals. Only the developer accepts items on My progress for what this implementation does on the DEV server. No tool awards progress.

realtime.rule: Refresh the listed reads when the event arrives (a list without a path id: every time; a detail read: when the payload names the same id). Never poll.
